data.name: Project Fear
data.description: You are capable of projecting horrifying images into the minds of your enemies.  As a standard action, you target one creature within %1 ft. and project these terrifying images into that creature's mind unless the creature makes a successful Will save (DC %2).  A failed save means the creature is shaken for %3 rounds.|ProjectFearRange|ProjectFearDC|ProjectFearDuration
